fixed: Your own figures and your notes on built-in figures now share a size limit, so they can never grow too large to fit in a backup. Reaching it says so and asks you to delete or shorten something; a Glossary that is already over the limit still opens and backs up, and can still be edited down. A backup larger than the limit restores as much as fits and reports the rest as skipped.
Offering a backup before connecting a sync store now says when the collection is too large to back up, with the sizes, instead of a generic failure.

changed: UserGlossaryRepository.upsert and FigureNoteRepository.set refuse a write that would take the glossary past maxUserGlossaryBytes (4 MiB of stored text plus a fixed overhead per row) and grow its row: UserGlossaryEntryInvalid.overBudget() (field 'budget') and FigureNoteInvalid(overBudget: true). A write that does not grow its row is always accepted.
